settings.heading: What you'll receive
settings.content:
A high-resolution digital file (JPEG and PNG), emailed straight to you. It's yours to print as many times as you like, at any size — a small desk frame, a big statement print, a mug, a tote, a card for the pet's other favourite human.

Personal use is completely yours. If you'd like to use your portrait commercially, just message me first and we'll sort it out.

settings.heading: Sending me your photos
settings.content:
As soon as you order, I'll email you. Reply with your favourite photos — clear, well lit, taken at their eye level if you can manage it. Two or three options are ideal so I can pick the one that draws best.

Old or blurry photos are welcome too, especially for pets who have passed away. Send them and I'll always tell you honestly what I can do.

settings.heading: Timings & changes
settings.content:
Most portraits are finished within 3-5 days. You'll see a preview before anything is final, and I'll happily tweak it until it feels like them — that's part of the price, not an extra.

Need it for a birthday or an anniversary? Tell me the date in your order notes and I'll do my very best.

settings.heading: Send me a photo
settings.text: Pick a photo where their personality shines through. A phone snap is perfect.

settings.heading: I start doodling
settings.text: Every line by hand, matching their markings, their ears, that one wonky whisker.

settings.heading: You see a preview
settings.text: I send a first look and tweak anything you'd like changed.
